scope: Final source checker, renderer, fifteen regression cases, authoring guide and semantic harness; read-only source/evidence review with an inexpensive independently parsed observed-client gate audit.
checker_review: Protected inline spans are consumed atomically before literal code, including multi-expression prose; blanking preserves offsets and math-fence ranges.
Bare inline/display styles, display literal less-than, un-commented physical row separators and literal inline table pipes are diagnosed within the stated source conventions.
Table rule is deliberately limited to pipe-leading rows, preserving outside-table norm escapes. Tests cover the failed table escape, Vert alias and unaffected outside-table expression.
Known TeX brace/environment/macro checks remain; literal fenced and multiline inline code are excluded. No new correctness issue found in the current book corpus.
renderer_and_harness_review: Renderer loads base/AMS/boldsymbol, resets each conversion, and fails on checker or SVG errors.
Semantic harness verifies stored API response digests, ordered counts and display kinds; compares original and repaired-source serialized MathML exactly.

Client replay parses actual API HTML into a first DOM, reproduces the observed temporary HTMLDocument document.write/textContent transformation, trims delimiters and compares its MathML against the same original.
Harness does not silently accept failures: after02 retained its sole table mismatch and nonzero exit; after03 now retains all 1871 exact source and client matches.

observed_client_gates.brace_proxy_rule: this.textContent.split("{").length, i.e. open-brace count plus one; uses observed first DOM text, including escaped brace characters.
observed_client_gates.true_expansion_limit_boundary: Not independently instrumented in GitHub deployed MathJax. No authored macro definitions/recursion are part of this corpus; pinned local full conversion is separately retained by root.

guide_review: Protected inline, fenced display, lt, EOL percent comment and table Vert conventions match the actually observed failure modes.
Document now promises MathML/content/order preservation after the explicit equivalent spellings, rather than falsely preserving all raw bodies after those deltas.
Historical local and peer receipts remain bound to their historical source revisions.
limits: Checker is intentionally conservative, not a full Markdown/TeX parser; table detection here assumes the canonical pipe-leading table style.
Harness reproduces observed client decoding and pinned local MathJax3.2.2; it does not execute the whole GitHub client, sanitizer, deployed MathJax or live browser layout.

Safety gates were inspected from pinned observed first-party client source and audited against actual after03 first-DOM payloads. Global page budgets assume these canonical single-file book pages or the retained synthetic API batches; arbitrary combined future pages are outside scope.
Previous peer-review-01-05.json remains valid for the initial delimiter-only revision, not final raw-body equality after semantic spelling deltas.
No source/book/notebook or historical receipt edited and no tests/model experiments rerun; only this final review receipt was written.
